Package gui

Class VisitHistoryController

java.lang.Object
gui.VisitHistoryController
All Implemented Interfaces:
IVisitHistory, Initializable
public class VisitHistoryController extends Object implements Initializable, IVisitHistory
Controller for the Visit History view. This class handles displaying the past reservations and visits of a subscriber. It uses a TableView to present the reservation details, including date, time, number of guests, and reservation status.
